versionCode: 105

### Whats New (08-16-25 Build)

  - nightly.sh: bump pulled commits from 25 to 40 (discord bots can exceed discord character limit for users)
  - TaskExecutor.java: replsce @noinspection EmptyMethod with @noinspection EmptyMethod, unchecked
  - suppress record class suggestion in TankAmmoSection.java
  - vehicle info fragment: replace length() == 0)  with isEmpty()
  - changelogActivity: replace (jsonArray.size() == 0) with (jsonArray.isEmpty()) and same for assets
  - fix all grouped text being "planes"
  - format code
  - code fixes via code analyzer suggestions
  - Update view_toolbar_tabs.xml
  - group XMLs: set textview background(s) from 55% opaque black to 45% opaque black
  - grouped radar xml: bump gradient alphas and radar anim. alpha
  - build.gradle: bump versionName and versionCode
  - nightly.sh: fix duplicate CHANGELOG_TEXT variable
  - app header: reduce text size (again again, final final lol)
  - splashscreen xml: reduce app icon size a little
  - header: adjust bottom margin again (lol) and increase text size to what it was before (40.0sp)
  - format code
  - adjust bottom margin for header textview
  - tighten up and improve design for news and updates
  - new header font / redesign shadow, decrease text size and adjust top margin
  - grouped weaponry xml: reduce cardview height by 10dp (160dp --> 150dp)
  - grouped radar fragment xml: adjust marginBottom from 8dp to 12dp to unify textview design
  - nightly.sh: beautify
  - nightly.sh: output commits to the changelog.json file as well to automate the handling of in-app changelogs
  - changelog xml: fix scrollview wrapping and set to match_parent, adjust some margins
  - nightly.sh: set commit pull from 1 day only (TO DO: infuse my changelog script logic into nightly.sh to select how long to pull from each run OR mark when last build ran, then  read X days ago) + set default versioncode to 105 (i think the logic is fucked up for now)
  - grouped radar fragment: increase radar animation cardview height +25dp (240dp --> 265dp)
  - grouped radar fragment xml: streamline textview design to match vehicle groups
  - Update grouped_weaponry_fragment.xml
  - grouped weaponry fragment xml: adjust card height to prevent bottom navigation overlapping it (TO DO: programmatically set bottom margin equivalent to bottom nav height + 8)
  - grouped weaponry fragment xml: streamline textview design with grouped vehicles
  - nightly.sh start notif. : use a multiline block (preserves literal newlines)
  - format code
  - bump gradle
  - bump AGP
  - update russian strings
  - bump versionCode and versionName
  - Update gradle.properties

  - nighlty.sh: fix messup
